texts.facts: This Writ Petition has been filed as a Public Interest Litigation seeking for a direction to the respondents to take effective steps to protect the life of the Tamil Nadu Fishermen fishing in Arabic Ocean, Gulf of Mannar and Bay of Bengal and Balk Bay by providing safety life jackets to the fishermen in Tamil Nadu at free of cost and for a consequential direction to the respondents to provide rehabilitation assistance to the fishermen who were affected by 'Cyclone Ockhi'. , it is submitted that due to gusty winds and severe storm, fishing boats are advised to reach to the nearest fishing harbours of various coastal States for safe berthing. fishermen landed at various states who had faced shortage of food materials and fuel for returning to their original berthing base in the afermath of cyclone Ockhi as weather conditions were improving, the Government had immediately sanctioned a sum of Rs.2.20 crore towards providing fuel to the fishing crafts berthed in other states to bring them back to home and also for providing financial assistance to meet out the ration expenses. In accordance with the Govt order, 205 boats with 1,568 fishermen were safely returned to their native places. , it is submitted that the following relief and rehabilitation packages have been announced by the Government and are implemented to restore normal life of the fishermen who were affected by cyclone Ockhi:- https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis The relief package announced by the Tamil Nadu Government Sl. 1. a)Fishermen who died or missing Rs.20 Lakhs due to Ocki cyclone 2. Fishermen injured / Disabled Rs.5 Lakh (could not do fishing in future) rehabilitation assistance 3. Hospitalized and under Rs.50,000/- treatment 4. An amount of Rs.8.445 crore was sanctioned from the State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF) towards payment of relief assistance for the damages caused to fishing boats and fishing implements due to OCKHI cyclone. is submitted that the Government of Tamil Nadu accords utmost priority for the safety and wellbeing of the fishermen of Tamil Nadu. This Government unequivocally enunciate the commitment for an all inclusive growth of Fisheries sector in the State to provide our fishermen fraternity the safety, security, enhanced livelihood opportunities, social security and quality of life for fishermen by pioneering in implementing multi various developmental and welfare schemes in fisheries and aquaculture sector.
texts.arguments: 3.According to the learned Additional Government Pleader, the aforesaid counter affidavit itself clearly states that steps have been taken by the Government to protect the Tamil Nadu fishermen.
